data.display_address: Beach Mansion, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
Discover contemporary coastal living in this elegant 1-bedroom residence at Beach Mansion Tower 1, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour. Offering a generous 1,233 sq ft of living space, this apartment blends modern design with resort-style luxury, ideal for those seeking a vibrant beachfront lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most prestigious waterfront communities.

Property Details:

This spacious 1-bedroom apartment is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and style. The bedroom features built-in wardrobes and an en-suite bathroom, complemented by an open-plan living and dining area that flows seamlessly onto a private balcony. Large windows invite abundant natural light while offering stunning views of the sea and surrounding skyline.
The contemporary kitchen is fully fitted with high-quality finishes and modern appliances, creating a functional and stylish space for everyday living.

1 Bedroom
1 Bathroom
1,233 sq ft
Open-plan living and dining area
Private balcony
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Fully fitted modern kitchen
Built-in wardrobes
Sea and community views

Community Amenities
Residents of Beach Mansion enjoy access to premium amenities designed for a luxurious beachfront lifestyle:

Private beach access
Infinity swimming pool
Fully equipped fitness center
Kids’ play area
Landscaped podium and leisure spaces
Retail and dining outlets within the community
24/7 security and concierge services

Location Highlights
Situated in the heart of Dubai Harbour, Emaar Beachfront offers unmatched connectivity and a resort-style environment:

Direct access to pristine private beaches
Minutes from Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah
Easy connectivity to Sheikh Zayed Road
Close to world-class dining, retail, and entertainment
Near Dubai Harbour Marina and yacht club

An exceptional opportunity to own a spacious beachfront home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after destinations.
